name: Noboru Lifts
description: Noboru Lifts — a landing-page theme for an office lift inspection and maintenance contractor. Open paper inside a 1 px hairline frame, a row of low-key lift photographs drifting left under a huge bold headline cut by the fold, every heading on solid ink strips, and three split visit cards that pin and slide over each other on a ruled grey grid band. Ink, paper and slate with one teal-to-blue call-to-action cell. Instrument Sans for headings, Albert Sans for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
